description:
Berlin population by 8 age groups, additionally by population group. Source: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg.

Parameters:
- rbs: "stadt" (city) | "bezirk" (Borough) | "stadtteil" | "ortsteil" (District) | "planungsraum" (Neighborhood, LOR Planungsraum)
- bevoelkerungsgruppe: "alle" (all) | "mit_migrationshintergrund" (with migration background) (optional)
- altersgruppe: age group, e.g. "alter_unter_6", "alter_65_und_mehr" (optional)
- bezirk_id, stadtteil_id, ortsteil_id, planungsraum_id: geographic filters
- start/end, recent, limit, fields, include: "metadata"

Key response fields (German names):
- bevoelkerungsgruppe_id: Population group ID
- bevoelkerungsgruppe_name: Population group
- altersgruppe_id: Age group ID
- altersgruppe_name: Age group
- anzahl_einwohner: Residents
name: socio_berlin_age_groups
title: Population by Age Group
